title: Advice
summary: ADVI'CE, noun [Latin viso, to see, to visit.] 1. Counsel; an opinion recommended, or offered, as worthy to be followed. What advice give ye? 2 Chronicles 10:9. With good advice make war. Proverbs 20:1

inlines.v: ADVI'CE, noun [Latin viso, to see, to visit.] 1. Counsel; an opinion recommended, or offered, as worthy to be followed. What advice give ye? 2 Chronicles 10:9. With good advice make war. Proverbs 20:18. We may give advice but we cannot give conduct. 2. Prudence; deliberate consideration. 3. Information; notice; intelligence; as, we have late advices from France. To take advice is to consult with others. ADVI'CE BOAT, noun A vessel employed to carry dispatches or information.
